name: GSG on cal short: bad GND contact (G lifted)

example.note: One ground tip lifted, as with a probe that is not planarized: the return current takes the other ground alone, which adds loop inductance. This example adds 50 pH, an estimate: FormFactor reports about four times the common-mode inductance for GS probes as for GSG, and published short models for Cascade probes are about 50 pH (GS) and 2 pH (GSG). On a short it hides: |S11| stays at 0 dB and the TDR edge moves by about 2 ps. It shows in the phase of S11, about 14° at 20 GHz and 46° at 67 GHz, which this tool does not plot yet.
example.author: TDR Painter
